design.heading: Six coverage areas the requirement set cannot carry, by construction:

areas.detail: what the thing does (often partially established by the hypotheses)
areas.name: Core functionality

areas.detail: who uses the system, who is affected beyond the primary user (admin, operator, support, auditor, regulator, third-party integrations)
areas.name: Stakeholders & user roles

areas.detail: what done looks like; how you'd know it's working
areas.name: Success criteria

areas.detail: probe at minimum: performance expectations, security requirements, reliability/uptime needs, and accessibility or platform constraints. Infer from context where obvious; only ask if the domain makes NFRs non-obvious or high-stakes.
areas.name: Non-functional concerns

areas.detail: tech, time, scope, regulatory, or design limits
areas.name: Constraints

areas.detail: what's explicitly not being built in this iteration
areas.name: Out of scope
